headline: Senate confirms federal judge Domenico while advancing tax relief bill toward finish line!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate confirmed Daniel Desmond Domenico to be a United States Circuit Judge for the Tenth Circuit by a vote of 51-46. The chamber continued debate on H.R. 2347, the Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act, with multiple amendments under consideration and a cloture vote successfully invoking closure on a Thune amendment. Three bills passed unanimously: the Improving Access to Workers' Compensation for Injured Federal Workers Act, the Shingle Springs Band of Miwok Indians Land Transfer Act, and the Safe Cloud Storage Act.

onTheFloor.title: Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act - tax relief bill serving as legislative vehicle for broader affordability and jobs measures
onTheFloor.status: Debate continuing with multiple amendments pending; cloture invoked 70-27 on Thune Amendment No. 6883; full consideration resuming Tuesday at 10 a.m.

onTheFloor.title: Improving Access to Workers' Compensation for Injured Federal Workers Act - expands workers' compensation to cover physician assistants and nurse practitioners
Shingle Springs Band of Miwok Indians Land Transfer Act - takes certain federal land in California into trust for the Shingle Springs Band of Miwok Indians
Safe Cloud Storage Act - limits liability for entities storing child sexual abuse material for law enforcement
